messages:
Sophie: Quick announcement: CI auth migration scheduled next week. We'll replace org PATs/service accounts with an OIDC-backed identity-proxy + GitHub Enterprise App. Cutover window: Tue 2026-04-06 02:00-04:00 UTC. Read below and flag blockers.

Ajay: Why a proxy instead of direct OIDC?

Sophie: Proxy centralizes token minting, supports legacy jobs that can't do direct OIDC, and issues short-lived scoped tokens for self-hosted runners.

Mara: Security win: eliminates long-lived PATs and reduces blast radius. We'll rotate a couple service keys during the cutover.

dan (devex): Reusable workflows using org PATs — what changes?

Sophie: Replace PAT usage with our helper action `redwood/infrabox/get-ci-token@v1`. We'll publish migration helpers and examples by Fri 2026-04-02.

BuildBot: infra/proxy@main deploy-check green :white_check_mark:

jules: Snippet please?

Sophie: Example step:
- name: Acquire CI token
  uses: redwood/infrabox/get-ci-token@v1
  with:
    audience: repo-deploy
This exchanges OIDC assertion with the proxy and sets an ephemeral token in GITHUB_ENV.

tom: Runner re-registration? We run in us-west+eu.

Ajay: No re-register required. Add PROXY_URL to runner env and restart; we'll publish a helper docker image for token refresh.

riley: Rollback plan?

Sophie: 1) Switch proxy to pass-through mode (~30s). 2) Re-enable org PATs for a temporary emergency window. 3) Revert workflow changes if needed. If auth-fail rate >5% for 15m, escalate to #incidents.

katie: I'll create Confluence migration doc + checklist and schedule a champions sync Mon 2026-04-05 18:00 UTC.

dan (devex): Canary: 5% traffic on Mon 2026-04-05, opt-in via `canary: true` flag on the action and adding your repo to the canary list.

jules: Noted. I'll test and report regressions.

BuildBot: canary-runner-01 job 4023 failed with `401 token` at 1930123590 — logging for triage.

Ajay: Found root cause: a post step used org PAT for a GH API call. PR to swap to proxy action incoming.

Sophie: Final cutover reminder will be posted 24h before. Compliance deadline to remove PATs: Apr 30 — this migration satisfies that. DM Sophie to join the canary list.

jules: DM sent, thanks!
